facts.text: Kid, heroes need protein, not complaints. Eat the lamb, stop whining, and do not look at the Hydra. Whatever you do.
facts.why: Phil does not say this in the film. The quote pages I opened show his real style (rookies, training heroes, dreams), and the Hydra line is invented.
facts.fix: Kid, eat up. Heroes train on a full stomach, and nobody fights the Hydra hungry.

vibe.verdict: Good Greek food and strong cartoon stills in a shared stadium frame, but the plot gags are thin.
